issue_request: FHIR-41181 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked that detailed definitions pages surface links for each element, such as ImagingStudy.started, so readers can find, save, and share element-specific anchors.

additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2023-11-06 confirm the missing element-details anchor affordance was an oversight and approved the Jira 9-0-0. The current core checkout uses the Kindling publisher dependency and already carries self-link CSS; build.fhir.org now shows a row-level link icon for ImagingStudy.started while R5 did not.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the authoritative row rendering logic lives in Kindling and the current generated specification already satisfies the requested behavior.
